### **CODEX: TORIL (THE CRADLE)**

**Overview**
Toril, formally known as Abeir-Toril, is the sapphire jewel of the Prime Material Plane. To the common traveler, it is simply "the world"—a vast, vibrant sphere of soaring peaks, deep oceans, and cities built upon the bones of forgotten empires. It is a realm defined by the pervasive hum of magic and the watchful, often meddlesome, eyes of the divine.

**History**
In the mists of the "Days of Thunder," Toril was a singular entity shared with its twin, Abeir. Following the catastrophic Dawn War between the gods and the primordials, the Overgod Ao sundered the two worlds to preserve peace. While Abeir was surrendered to the titans, Toril became the domain of the gods. Its annals are written in blood and wonder, marked by the fall of the sky-cities of Netheril, the devastation of the Spellplague, and the recent Second Sundering, which saw the world’s geography reshaped once more.

**Significance**
Toril is the anchor of the multiverse. It is the locus of the Weave—the silver thread of magic overseen by the goddess Mystra—which allows mortals to bend reality to their will. From the bustling trade hubs of the Sword Coast to the shifting sands of Anauroch, the planet serves as the primary battleground for the eternal struggle between cosmic Law and Chaos.

**Legends**
The most enduring myth concerns the sisters Selûne and Shar, whose primordial feud over light and shadow birthed the world and the Weave itself. Sages also whisper of the "World Serpent," an ancient power whose coils supposedly form the planet's core. It is said that should the gods ever truly abandon Toril, the Serpent will wake to swallow the sun, ending the age of mortals forever.
